detail.command:
set -e
if [ ! -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then
  echo '=== INSTALL DEPENDENCIES ==='
  npm ci
fi
printf '%s\n' '=== TYPECHECK ==='
npm run typecheck
printf '%s\n' '=== JEST ==='
npm test -- --runInBand
printf '%s\n' '=== LINT ==='
npm run lint
printf '%s\n' '=== IOS PRODUCTION BUNDLE ==='
BUNDLE_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$BUNDLE_DIR"' EXIT
npx react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output "$BUNDLE_DIR/main.jsbundle" --assets-dest "$BUNDLE_DIR/assets"
test -s "$BUNDLE_DIR/main.jsbundle"
echo 'OK: production iOS bundle generated'
